description: List the products that launched in one ship week (Monday-Sunday UTC, keyed YYYYMMDD). Defaults to the current week. During Fog Mode vote counts for the current week are hidden and the order is random.

category.description: Filter to one category. One of: developer-tools, design-tools, marketing-sales, finance, education, health-wellness, social, ecommerce, entertainment, ai-ml, travel, productivity, data-analytics, web3, security-privacy, hardware, media-news, other.

shipWeek.description: Monday of the week in YYYYMMDD form, for example '20260907'. Defaults to the current ship week.

sort.description: Vote order is forced to random while Fog Mode hides the current week's ranking.

name: list_ship_week
title: List a ship week
